title: What Are You Going to Do?

sections.content: You know *ir a* + infinitive from A1. In B1 you use it for plans you have already made, usually with a reason. This lesson adds three expressions that are new: *planear* and *tener previsto* (to plan) and *estar a punto de* (to be about to).

items.spanish: Voy a cambiar de trabajo porque quiero aprender algo nuevo.
items.english: I'm going to change jobs because I want to learn something new.

items.spanish: Vamos a salir temprano porque queremos llegar antes de las ocho.
items.english: We're going to leave early because we want to arrive before eight.

items.spanish: Marta tiene previsto estudiar en Chile el año que viene.
items.english: Marta plans to study in Chile next year.

items.spanish: Estamos a punto de empezar, así que prepara tus cosas.
items.english: We're about to start, so get your things ready.

sections.content: Reach for *ir a* + infinitive when the plan already exists before you speak, often with a reason: *Voy a estudiar más porque quiero aprender*. *Estar a punto de* + infinitive is for something that starts in a moment.
